integrity: The combinatorial proof is self-contained. Exact rational enumeration independently checks all positive sample-size pairs with total size through twelve and checks the conditional aggregate identity through total size forty. Finite checks are corroborative rather than a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem is for the common continuous two-sample null and the stated Cramér–von Mises normalization. It does not cover alternatives or tied pooled samples without an explicit tie rule.
title: Exact negative covariance between two-sample runs and Cramér–von Mises discrepancy
